summary.text: Sean Steeg is the Democratic candidate for Pennsylvania State Senate District 30 in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces incumbent Republican Judith Ward.
He is a co-founder and chief executive officer of Juniata Brewing Company and ran for Pennsylvania House District 81 in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Sean Steeg was born in Baltimore, Maryland, and graduated from Loyola Blakefield High School.
He earned a bachelor's degree from Juniata College in 2000.

His career experience includes working as the chief executive officer and co-founder of Juniata Brewing Company, which he described in a 2024 Ballotpedia survey as Huntingdon County's only production brewery.
Steeg ran for Pennsylvania House of Representatives District 81 in 2024, when incumbent Richard Irvin (R) defeated him in the general election.
He advanced from the Democratic primary for State Senate District 30 on May 19, 2026.
In the 2024 survey he named education and rural broadband among his priorities.
